cand.title: Journée RELAIS – Nyon, journée 2
cand.organizationName: CIC, Vaud Religious Affairs Directorate and UNIL ISS
cand.excerpt: Closest local public-sector fit; named administrations, shared lunch and direct organizer registration make meeting/catering outreach actionable.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Cécile Navarro is the strongest operational approach: the CIC explicitly identifies her as coordinator of Journées RELAIS since October 2025. Manéli Farahmand is CIC director and appears with Navarro in the first-day programme; she is relevant for organizational sponsorship and referral. Neither is publicly established as hotel-contract signatory or procurement budget holder. Approach via the published programme mailbox formation@cic-info.ch, asking for Navarro; CIC general contact is info@cic-info.ch / 022 735 47 50. These are institutional channels, not verified personal contact details.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming activity on 22 January 2027 in Nyon, within the requested horizon. The official activity page states “Date : 22 janvier 2027”; the 2026–2027 brochure independently confirms it. This is a single-day session, not an article publication date. Programme runs from a 09h15 welcome to a 16h45 closing item. Registration is possible until 8 January 2027. No subsequent Nyon edition with exact dates and venue was found in the official programme; do not extrapolate a 2028 Nyon date.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: YOTEL Geneva Lake is geographically relevant to this Nyon/La Côte activity, but the event is a locally anchored, single-day programme with lunch already included at a published non-hotel venue. Its 237 guestrooms and roughly 20–120-room commercial group band cannot be supported by any published event demand. Attendance is unknown, so fit against the hotel’s approximately 250-theatre capacity cannot be established. Conditional opportunities are individually required speaker/organizer overnights or a separately commissioned planning/training meeting, only if the organizer confirms need and transport practicality. This is not demonstrated residential-conference, resort-retreat or Geneva megashow overflow demand.
findings.venueCommitments: Published venue: Salle de La Colombière de l’Unité pastorale interculturelle de Nyon, Rue de la Colombière 18, Nyon, canton of Vaud, Switzerland. Territory: Nyon / La Côte; not Founex, Geneva city or Lausanne. This is a religious-community hall, not an incumbent hotel. Official venue publication establishes the announced location, not evidence of a signed rental contract or exclusive catering agreement.
findings.historicalRotation: RELAIS is a new programme launched in 2026, not a proven annually rotating Nyon conference. Launch evening: 9 June 2026, 18h00–20h00, Espace Maurice Zundel, Boulevard de Grancy 19, Lausanne. First thematic day: 2 October 2026, Nouvelle Mosquée de Renens, Rue de Crissier 9, Renens. Next announced stops are Nyon on 22 January 2027 and Payerne in April/May 2027; the latter has no exact day or named venue published. The canton also mentions Yverdon-les-Bains and Vevey as programme localities without dated editions. Three thematic days per year is an explicit programme design, not proof of repeat Nyon dates. CORPES 2019–2025 is a predecessor training programme, not historical editions of this event.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No housing bureau, host hotel, edition-specific hotel list, room block, room-night figure or open accommodation RFP was identified in the official event page, programme, brochure or registration form. No hotels are listed in those materials. Relevant published scope: “Le prix de la journée est de 60 CHF, repas de midi compris” and “L’inscription se fait à la journée ou pour plusieurs journées ... formation@cic-info.ch ou via le formulaire en ligne.” The form states “La participation à la journée ne se fait qu’en présentiel.” These quotations establish day attendance and lunch inclusion, not hotel sourcing or self-booking instructions.
findings.organizationStructure: Public-sector / academic / foundation collaboration: Direction des affaires religieuses du Canton de Vaud, Centre intercantonal d’information sur les croyances (CIC), and Institut des sciences sociales de l’Université de Lausanne (ISS/UNIL). CIC has a foundation board and administers the published registration channel. Ville de Nyon is the local event partner; the Unité pastorale interculturelle supplies the announced venue context. No PCO, DMC, commercial agency or hotel housing intermediary is identified in the reviewed materials. Do not equate the municipal speakers or venue representatives with accommodation buyers.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The principal limitation is the already announced community venue and included lunch, not a competing hotel commitment. Local community exchanges are central to the content, reducing the rationale for moving the core day to a Founex hotel (inference). The lunch supplier, catering exclusivity and payment arrangement are not published. No competing hotel, lodging shortage, spillover, transfer arrangement or overflow evidence was found. Unpublished accommodation demand is unknown, not zero.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Send a short French-language introduction to formation@cic-info.ch for Cécile Navarro, with Manéli Farahmand as the senior referral. Acknowledge the 22 January date and La Colombière venue; do not pitch venue replacement. Ask whether any non-local speakers or organizers require overnight stays, who books/pays, whether lodging is already arranged, and whether a separate planning meeting is contemplated. Request numbers, stay dates, budget and transport expectations before quoting. Only after a confirmed requirement offer a right-sized ancillary room or meeting proposal; otherwise maintain a low-priority relationship for later La Côte sessions.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: Participant registration is published through CIC until 8 January 2027, at CHF 60 including lunch; this is not a supplier RFP or evidence of open hotel procurement. The core meeting venue is announced elsewhere. Any January 2027 hotel business is limited to needs not disclosed publicly and must first be confirmed with the coordinator; do not treat all attendees as accessible room demand.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Conditional relationship-development potential only. Three thematic days per year and multiple Vaud localities support continuing organizer engagement, but no dated later Nyon/Founex edition or hotel-venue tender was identified. The programme’s community-based format limits assumptions of hotel substitution. Seek a future La Côte planning session or ancillary overnight role rather than claiming capture of the announced 2027 venue or room inventory.
